website.note: Pipeline page lists detalimogene (EG-70) for NMIBC; LEGEND clinical trial referenced.

ctgov.note: Single active P1/P2 RECRUITING study (NCT04752722, LEGEND).

pipeline.modality: Non-viral gene therapy (DDX dually-derivatized chitosan delivery of plasmid encoding immune cargo via Nature Technology Corp Nanoplasmid vector)
pipeline.target: Local intra-tumoral immune activation (innate immune response in bladder mucosa)
pipeline.license_origin: Internal program; Nanoplasmid vector backbone in-licensed from Nature Technology Corporation (2020)

indications.indication: Non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) with carcinoma in situ (CIS) — BCG-unresponsive (pivotal cohort)
indications.trial_design: Open-label Phase 1/2; Phase 2 has three cohorts. Cohort 1 (pivotal) = BCG-unresponsive NMIBC with CIS ± concomitant papillary disease, enrollment complete with 125 patients.
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING (Cohort 1 enrollment complete; Cohorts 2 and 3 ongoing). Primary completion date 2026-06-30. BLA submission planned 2H 2026.
key_milestones: Interim Milestone achieved per Hercules loan agreement

indications.trial_design: Open-label expansion cohort of LEGEND; high-risk BCG-naïve NMIBC with CIS
Open-label expansion cohort; high-risk BCG-exposed NMIBC with CIS
Open-label cohort; high-risk BCG-unresponsive NMIBC papillary disease only (no CIS)

summary_counts.note: 1 unique asset (detalimogene voraplasmid) with 4 active Phase 2 indications across LEGEND cohorts. All under single trial NCT04752722.
